animationsDescription: Animate panels, lists and theme changes. System reduced motion takes precedence.
typewriterModeDescription: Keep the writing line near the center of the page.
categoryAppearanceDescription: A comfortable space for your writing.
categoryEditorDescription: How the page answers what you write.
categoryKeymapDescription: Keys by what they act on.
scopeEditingDescription: Write, move and select on the page.
scopeSheetsDescription: Make, find, switch and close sheets.
scopeLibraryDescription: File, rename and trash what the field shows, and go between places.
scopeViewDescription: Change what the window shows around your sheet.
typefaceDescription: The style the prose is set in, and the glyph forms of Chinese and Japanese. A face for them downloads once from Google Fonts and stays on this computer.
typefaceKeywords: Fonts Faces Style Serif Sans Writing Systems Download Google Fonts Chinese Japanese Han Kanji Noto
systemFontNote: The system's own, nothing to download
chineseAndJapaneseDescription: The glyph forms they are drawn in. A face downloads when chosen.
styleDescription: Latin text is set in Noto Serif or Noto Sans, and Chinese and Japanese in its match.
interfaceDescription: The colors, size and language of Neverland's own windows; sheets keep theirs.
interfaceKeywords: Theme Colors Starfield Daybreak Dark Light UI Font Size Language Translation Locale
themeDescription: Starfield is the dark Cosmofi scheme; Daybreak is its light counterpart.
uiFontSizeDescription: Scales chrome; document text keeps its own size.
writingEnvironmentDescription: Presentation choices shared across the workspace.
documentTextSizeDescription: Prose, headings and column scale together in every window.
spacingDescription: From compact to loose: a body line's height over its text's size. The room around headings, lists and code follows in proportion.
turnOnToAdjust: {count, plural, other {Turn on to adjust # options.}}
findShortcutDescription: Find an action by pressing its keys, or put every key back as it was.
pressShortcutToFind: Press a shortcut to find it
pressShortcutToFindAction: Press a shortcut to find its action.
keptInAppMenu: {keys} is kept by “{action}” in the app menu.
couldntMoveGroupToTrash: Couldn't move the group to the Trash
couldntMoveSheetToTrash: Couldn't move the sheet to the Trash
restoredFromBackup: The notebook was restored from its latest backup
restoredFromBackupDescription: It was damaged; the damaged copy is kept.
notebookDamagedDescription: No backup could be read, so it starts empty; the damaged copy is kept.
settingsResetDescription: Your notebook is unchanged. The saved preferences could not be read.
fontMismatch: The download wasn't the font expected. Try again later.
fontDownloadFailed: Couldn't download. Check the connection and try again.
dragToFile: Drag a sheet to file it
keptHint: Searches kept rest here, to be found again.
moveToTrashWithSheets: {count, plural, other {Move to Trash with # Sheets}}
trayHint: Set sheets aside here. Emptied, each goes back where it was.
languageDescription: Menus, settings and notices. Sheets keep the words they are written in.
languageSystemNote: Follows the languages of this computer
policiesCoreDescription: Every keystroke is an edit of the page: {core_break} starts a new block, {core_softBreak} breaks the line inside one.
policiesFormatsDescription: {formats_strong}, {formats_emphasis} and {formats_code} format the selection, or what you type next at the caret.
policiesBlocksDescription: Turn the blocks you are in into headings, code or a quote, and back into paragraphs.
policiesFormulasDescription: $ writes a formula in the text; $ again at its end steps out, and $$ alone opens a math block.
policiesNotationDescription: How the page spells its marks and markers as you write them.
policiesMarkdownDescription: Type markdown and the page takes the shape it spells, including task markers.
policiesWordsDescription: Move, select and delete by word, sentence or paragraph; {core_wordLeft} and {core_wordRight} move by word.
policiesTypographyDescription: Typographic symbols, apostrophes, punctuation spacing and quote placement as you write.
policiesCjkDescription: Punctuation width and spacing between Chinese, Japanese or Korean and Latin text.
policiesListsDescription: {lists_nest} nests an item, {lists_outdent} steps it out; {core_break} in an empty item leaves the list. Reshape blocks into bulleted or numbered lists.
policiesTablesDescription: {table_insert} places a table; {core_leave} and {core_return} step between its cells, and {core_break} goes down a column, making a row past the last.
policiesFiguresDescription: Pictures dropped, pasted or inserted with {figures_insert} become figures with captions, a pasted Markdown picture captioned by its alt text; {core_dismiss} moves between a figure and its caption.
policiesTagsDescription: # and a word writes a tag anywhere in the text; each sheet collects the tags it writes.
policiesPairsDescription: Brackets and quotes close themselves as you open them; deleting into a pair selects it first.
policiesNavigationDescription: Leave and Return move through the roles selected below; {core_leave} leaves, {core_return} goes back.
policiesScopesDescription: {core_selectAll} grows the selection through the scopes around the caret; {core_dismiss} returns to the caret.
policiesDeletionDescription: A structure is armed by the first delete and removed by the next; a selected picture goes at once, and text pairs keep their own sides.
policiesGuidesDescription: Show a key where it would act: leaving a scope, or going back.
policiesHistoryDescription: Undo and redo step through your edits, a burst of typing at a time.
policiesFeedbackDescription: A pulse shows what typography or CJK changed; undo plays it backward and redo forward.
policiesFindDescription: Find in a sheet marks every match as you type, and steps from one to the next.
policiesStatisticsDescription: Word, character and CJK counts for the page and the selection, shown in the footer.
settingsMarkdownHeadingsDescription: # at a line's start makes a heading, one level per #.
settingsMarkdownListsDescription: - or 1. at a line's start starts a list.
settingsMarkdownQuotesDescription: > at a line's start starts a quote.
settingsMarkdownCodeDescription: `code` marks code; ``` and Enter opens a code block.
settingsMarkdownMathDescription: $$ and Enter opens a math block.
settingsMarkdownTablesDescription: Return after a row typed between pipes, such as | Tide | Height |, makes it a table's header.
settingsNotationRevealDescription: Whether marks show their signs, as *this*, or only their style.
settingsNotationUnderscoresDescription: Emphasis and strong show _ and __ instead of * and **.
settingsWordsNearbyContentDescription: Double-click spaces or tabs to select nearby text or an inline object, without crossing a line break. Blank lines keep their whitespace selection.
settingsTypographySymbolsDescription: Write ... and -- as … and — while typing.
settingsTypographyPunctuationDescription: Put a space after commas, semicolons and colons as they are typed.
settingsTypographyQuotePlacementDescript: Curl apostrophes and move terminal punctuation inside closing quotes.
settingsCjkPunctuationDescription: Use full-width punctuation on lines written in Chinese, Japanese or Korean.
settingsCjkSpacingDescription: Put one space between adjacent CJK and Latin text.
settingsDeletionRolesDescription: Which structures require a first delete to arm them, then a second to remove them.
settingsNavigationRolesDescription: Which scope kinds Leave and Return move through.
settingsPairsAutoCloseDescription: Typing an opener types its closer, unless a word follows.
settingsPairsOvertypeDescription: Typing a closer right before a pair's closer moves past it, however it was typed.
settingsPairsQuotesDescription: Straight double quotes pair like brackets; after a word one closes.
settingsPairsMatesDescription: Backspace or Delete into a pair selects it whole; the next press deletes both sides together.
settingsHistoryTypingWindowDescription: Typing within this pause of the last keystroke undoes together.
settingsPairsMates: Select a pair before deleting it
settingsFormulasDialectDescription: Syntax used for newly created inline formulas and math blocks. Existing formulas keep their own dialect.
